stem_book: An L.P.G. cylinder weighs 14.8 kg when empty. When full, it weighs 29.0 kg and shows a pressure of 2.5 atm. During use at 27 °C, the weight of the cylinder reduces to 23.2 kg. Find the volume of n-butane in cubic metres used up at 27 °C and 1 atm. (Molecular mass of butane = 58 g mol⁻¹) (a) 1.22 m³ (b) 1.89 m³ (c) 2.46 m³ (d) 3.00 m³
